name: Kana Seihajuu Oosaka
original_name: カーナ・セイハジュウ・オオサカ
source:
Kana Seihajuu Oosaka, is a girl whom Rance met in front of the Rekka Mines. She's 17, likes to eat melon bread and enjoys mountain climbing. 

[From [url=https://alicesoft.fandom.com/wiki/Kana_Seihaju_Oosaka]AliceSoft Wiki[/url]]
